description: Trace the impact of a Proofhub bug export (blast radius + traceability).
example-prompts: analyze impact of this bug export|trace blast radius of my Proofhub CSV|what does fixing these bugs affect|impact analysis from bugs
prompt-template: Please analyze the impact of my Proofhub bug export at {proofhub_csv} on the project at {project_path}

description: Trace the impact of a BRD document (.docx/.md/.txt) on the codebase.
example-prompts: analyze impact of this BRD|requirements blast radius|what does building this BRD affect|impact from requirements document
prompt-template: Please analyze the impact of my BRD at {brd_doc} on the project at {project_path}

description: Combined impact analysis from a bug export and a BRD.
example-prompts: analyze impact from both bugs and BRD|combined impact analysis|bugs and requirements together
prompt-template: Please analyze the combined impact of my bug export at {proofhub_csv} and BRD at {brd_doc} on the project at {project_path}

description: List all supported stacks and engine IDs for impact analysis.
example-prompts: list impact analysis engines|what stacks does impact analysis support|show available engines
prompt-template: Please list all available impact analysis engines and supported stacks
